"""Build and compare independent lab3 variants on Linux ARM; never installs over a course project."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, datetime, hashlib, json, os, re, statistics, subprocess, tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
VARIANTS = {'baseline': 'graphic-baseline.c', 'serial': 'graphic-serial.c', 'parallel': 'graphic.c'}

def parse_metrics(output):
    patterns = {'pixel': r'draw pixel:\s*(\d+) ms', 'rect': r'draw rect:\s*(\d+) ms',
                'line': r'draw line:\s*(\d+) ms', 'jpg': r'\*\*jpeg:\s*(\d+)',
                'png': r'\*\*png:\s*(\d+)', 'font': r'\*\*font:\s*(\d+)',
                'text': r'draw text:\s*(\d+) ms', 'total': r'Total time:\s*(\d+) ms'}
    values = {}
    for name, pattern in patterns.items():
        matches = re.findall(pattern, output)
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise ValueError('Missing or duplicate timing: ' + name)
        values[name] = int(matches[0])
    if values['total'] != sum(values[k] for k in values if k != 'total'):
        raise ValueError('Total differs from seven stage timings')
    return values

def snapshot():
    values = {}
    for pattern in ('/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy*/scaling_*',
                    '/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/temp', '/proc/loadavg'):
        import glob
        for name in glob.glob(pattern):
            try:
                if Path(name).is_file(): values[name] = Path(name).read_text().strip()
            except (OSError, UnicodeError): pass
    return values

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--project', required=True, help='Existing course project, used only for external libraries')
    parser.add_argument('--build-only', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--runs', type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument('--threads', type=int, default=2)
    parser.add_argument('--threshold', type=int, default=65536)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.runs < 1 or args.runs > 20 or args.threads < 1 or args.threads > 64 or args.threshold < 1:
        parser.error('Invalid runs, threads or threshold')
    if os.name != 'posix': parser.error('Run on the Linux board; this is not a Windows build')
    project = Path(args.project).resolve(strict=True)
    external = project / 'common/external'
    if not (external / 'include').is_dir() or not (external / 'lib').is_dir():
        parser.error('Missing course common/external/include or lib')
    manifest = json.loads((ROOT / 'manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    for name, expected in manifest['sourceHashes'].items():
        if hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() != expected:
            raise RuntimeError('Package file changed: ' + name)
    record = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='board-comparison-', dir=str(ROOT)))
    print('Records:', record, flush=True)
    compiler = subprocess.run(['gcc','--version'], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    (record/'compiler.txt').write_text(compiler)
    environment = dict(os.environ)
    environment['LD_LIBRARY_PATH'] = str(external/'lib') + os.pathsep + environment.get('LD_LIBRARY_PATH','')
    environment['OMP_NUM_THREADS'] = str(args.threads)
    environment['OMP_DYNAMIC'] = 'FALSE'
    # Do not inherit hidden settings that alter team size, nesting or placement.
    environment['OMP_THREAD_LIMIT'] = str(args.threads)
    environment['OMP_MAX_ACTIVE_LEVELS'] = '1'
    results = {'recordedAt':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
               'threads':args.threads, 'threshold':args.threshold, 'compiler':compiler,
               'packageManifest':manifest, 'runs':[], 'commands':{},
               'courseTimingExcludesFlush':True, 'flushTimingsRecordedSeparately':True}
    for variant, graphic in VARIANTS.items():
        directory = record/variant
        out = directory/'out'
        out.mkdir(parents=True)
        for name in ('test.jpg','test.png','font.ttc'):
            (out/name).symlink_to(ROOT/'out'/name)
        flags = ['-Wall','-O3']
        if variant == 'parallel': flags += ['-fopenmp','-DFB_PARALLEL_MIN_PIXELS='+str(args.threshold)]
        graphics_unit = directory/'graphics-build.c'
        graphics_unit.write_text('#define fb_update fb_update_impl\n#include '+json.dumps(str(ROOT/'common'/graphic))+'\n')
        command = ['gcc',*flags,'-I'+str(ROOT/'common'),'-I'+str(external/'include'),
                   str(graphics_unit),
                   str(ROOT/'common/image.c'), str(ROOT/'common/task.c'),
                   str(ROOT/'test/main.c'), str(ROOT/'flush_probe.c'),
                   '-L'+str(external/'lib'), '-ljpeg','-lfreetype','-lpng','-lasound','-lz','-lm',
                   '-o',str(out/'test')]
        results['commands'][variant] = command
        compiled = subprocess.run(command, env=environment, capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180)
        (directory/'build.log').write_text(compiled.stdout+compiled.stderr)
        if compiled.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError('Build failed: '+str(directory/'build.log'))
        if not args.build_only:
            subprocess.run(['python3',str(ROOT/'preflight.py'),'--project',str(directory),'--lab','test'],check=True)
    if not args.build_only:
        names = list(VARIANTS)
        for iteration in range(args.runs):
            # Rotate order to reduce always giving one variant the cold run.
            for variant in names[iteration%3:] + names[:iteration%3]:
                out = record/variant/'out'
                before = snapshot()
                run = subprocess.run([str(out/'test')],cwd=out,env=environment,
                                     capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=90)
                logfile = record/variant/('run-%02d.log'%(iteration+1))
                logfile.write_text(run.stdout+run.stderr)
                if run.returncode: raise RuntimeError('Test failed: '+str(logfile))
                metrics = parse_metrics(run.stdout)
                flush = [float(v) for v in re.findall(r'FLUSH_US=(\d+)',run.stderr)]
                if not flush: raise RuntimeError('Missing flush timing: '+str(logfile))
                results['runs'].append({'variant':variant,'iteration':iteration+1,'timingsMs':metrics,
                    'flushUs':flush,'before':before,'after':snapshot(),'log':str(logfile)})
                print(variant,metrics,flush=True)
                (record/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
        results['medianMs'] = {v:{k:statistics.median(r['timingsMs'][k] for r in results['runs'] if r['variant']==v)
                                  for k in results['runs'][0]['timingsMs']} for v in VARIANTS}
        print(json.dumps(results['medianMs'],indent=2))
    (record/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
    print('Done:', record)

if __name__ == '__main__': main()
